1.name: Dry Sahel
1.rotation: Millet or sorghum with cowpea or groundnut

2.name: Savanna
2.pattern: One rainy season. Soils low in nutrients.
2.rotation: Maize or sorghum, then soybean or groundnut

3.name: Wet forest
3.pattern: Very wet all year. Acid soils.

4.name: Highlands
4.pattern: Cool, often two rainy seasons. Rich soils.

5.name: Southern woodland
5.pattern: One rainy season, November to April.

6.name: Very dry land
6.rotation: Few options. Drought-tolerant crops or irrigation

7.name: Floodplains
7.pattern: Land floods each season. Rich soils.
